title: Owed Group-Context Unseen Evaluation
rule: Frozen before first scoring; no tuning until original results retained.

cases.label: Named small reimbursement
cases.transcript:
Jules: I picked up the keycards.
Nia: Great.
Jules: Nia, please send me $6.40 for your card.

cases.label: Named incoming loan
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, I still owe you $18.25 from the market.
Nia: Just remember it.

cases.label: Shared budget no demand
cases.transcript:
Jules: Our booth was $84 for four people.
Nia: Ah okay.
Ola: We should sort it out soon.

cases.label: Everyone should pay someone
cases.transcript:
Jules: Everyone needs to send their $21 share.
Nia: Where do we send it?
Ola: We'll confirm later.

cases.label: Ambiguous reply to previous ping
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, are you around?
Nia: Yep.
Jules: Cool, send me $9 for the gate pass.

cases.label: Third-party reference
cases.transcript:
Jules: Ola still owes me $33 for the heater.
Nia: Have you reminded him?
Ola: I'll get to it.

cases.label: Request directed to different member
cases.transcript:
Jules: Ola, send me $4.50 for the train.
Nia: I'll check the timetable.
Ola: Okay.

cases.label: Mention of name is not address
cases.transcript:
Jules: I think Nia already covered the $14 cost.
Ola: Fair.
Nia: I'm checking.

cases.label: At-handle direct money
cases.transcript:
Ola: @Nia, send me $7.75 for the printed badge.
Nia: Noted.

cases.label: Em dash direct money
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia — send me $3 for the paper tickets.
Nia: Fine.

cases.label: Observer no assignment
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $5 for tolls.
Nia: Okay.

cases.label: Mixed-case speaker identity
cases.transcript:
NIA: Has anyone checked the key?
Jules: Nia, send me $4 for your copy.
Ola: Okay.

cases.label: Similar names no cross-attribution
cases.transcript:
Sam: Here.
Samantha: Ready.
Ola: Samantha, send me $16. Sam, just take photos.

cases.label: Genitive is not direct addressee
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia's share was $19, by the way.
Nia: That's what I remembered.
Ola: I can ask.

cases.label: Nickname not declared alias
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nee, send $12 for the printer ink.
Nia: Did you mean me?
Ola: Not sure.

cases.label: Quoted instruction in reported speech
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, remember how Ola joked 'send me $40 or else' yesterday?
Nia: lol.
Ola: 😂

cases.label: Gift waiver same sentence
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, don't pay me $11 for the flowers; they're a gift.
Nia: Thanks.
Ola: Sweet.

cases.label: Conditional ticket approval
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $28 only if the organiser confirms your seat.
Nia: Has it been confirmed?
Jules: Not yet.

cases.label: Subsequently acknowledged payment
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $13 for the hall.
Nia: Sent it already.
Jules: Got the $13 just now, we're settled.

cases.label: Correction later in conversation
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $22 for the equipment.
Ola: That's the old amount.
Jules: Nia, I meant $17, not $22. Please send $17.

cases.label: Two coordinated deliverables
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me the revised agenda and the speaker list.
Nia: I'll forward them.

cases.label: Two independent instructions different lines
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, forward the loading instructions.
Ola: Nia, share the venue address.
Nia: I'll handle it.

cases.label: Asking for two details, polite form
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, could you send me the access link and the floor map?
Nia: Yep.

cases.label: Conjunction inside object name
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me a photo of Ada and Bisi.
Nia: I have it.

cases.label: Money and separately requested task
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $2 for the clipboards.
Ola: Nia, send the sign-in sheet.
Nia: Sure.

cases.label: Other person's debt and own task
cases.transcript:
Jules: Ola, send me $17 for the USB hub.
Ola: Okay.
Jules: Nia, share the workshop link.

cases.label: Group bill plus explicit own remainder
cases.transcript:
Jules: The venue was $96, shared across six people.
Ola: So $16 each.
Jules: Nia, please send me your remaining $8.
Nia: I had paid half yesterday.

cases.label: Hey-name direct request
cases.transcript:
Ola: Hey Nia, send me $5.25 for the shuttle ride.
Nia: Will do.

cases.label: Explicit named non-debt
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, you don't owe me $15 anymore, I paid for both.
Nia: Cheers.

cases.label: Named incoming money debt no payable
cases.transcript:
Ola: Nia, I owe you $9 for the textbook, promise I'll settle next week.
Nia: Thanks.

cases.label: Multi-line continuation under speaker
cases.transcript:
Ola: Nia, can you forward the delivery address
and the permit PDF?
Nia: I can do that.

cases.label: Two competing direct requests, selected one
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $6 for the tea.
Ola: Zed, send me $11 for your own tea.
Nia: Okay.
Zed: Fine.

cases.label: Aliased addressee unknown
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nina, please transfer $30 for the projector.
Nia: My name here is Nia, is that directed to me?
Ola: Not sure.

cases.label: Narrated direct request to third party
cases.transcript:
Jules: I told Ola to send me $12, Nia.
Nia: Ah okay.
Ola: Yep.

cases.label: No participant chosen
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $7 for the bag tags.
Nia: Got it.

cases.label: Invented participant not present
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $7 for the bag tags.
Nia: Got it.

cases.label: Two concrete objects without articles
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, forward the flyers and receipts.
Nia: I can do it.

cases.label: Third-party request named inside answer
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, I need to hear from Ola. Can you call him?
Nia: Yup.

cases.label: Overlapping name inside sentence
cases.transcript:
Jo: Everyone agrees Mariana will send the file and Ana will review it.
Ana: I haven't agreed to anything.
Mariana: I said I'd send.

cases.label: Mixed speaker corrections & task
cases.transcript:
Jules: Nia, send me $8 for the leaflets.
Nia: I'm sure I already did.
Jules: Ah yes, received. Nia, forward the corrected poster instead.
